hints.title: Consecutive Duplicate Consolidation
hints.text: Plateaus of equal adjacent values act as single points for hill and valley determination.

hints.title: Condensed Array Transformation
hints.text: Compress consecutive identical numbers so that each adjacent pair consists of different values.

hints.title: Strict Extrema Verification
hints.text: An index i is a hill if v[i] > v[i - 1] and v[i] > v[i + 1], or a valley if v[i] < v[i - 1] and v[i] < v[i + 1].

hints.title: Deduped Extrema Scan

complexity.notes: Single deduplication pass followed by single neighbor comparison pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning left and right repeatedly for the first non-equal neighbor is O(n^2) worst-case.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Condensed array uses at most O(n) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles flat plateaus cleanly through deduplication.
